item.title: Islanders win season opener 11-1 over Stonehill College, Watkins deals 7 strikeouts
item.description: Islanders starting pitcher Preston Watkins dealt 7 strikeouts in their season opener. Texas A&M-Corpus Christi continues their series with Stonehill College on Saturday with a double-header at 2 p.m.

item.title: 4A No. 1 Calallen falls short to 6A No. 15 Weslaco 4-2 in Wildcat Classic tournament
item.description: Calallen's third inning lead came up short. On Saturday, Calallen will play state rival Liberty at 9 a.m. at Teresa Flores Lentz Field, and then the Lady Cats will face Veterans Memorial at 1 p.m.

item.title: Veterans Memorial gets revenge on Ray, Eagles win 68-65 pulling ahead in District 29-5A
item.description: The Veterans Memorial Eagles (22-9, 13-2) got revenge against the Ray Texans (25-9, 12-3) on Friday, winning 68-65. Ray won their first meeting 66-63. #RecruitTheCoast
